summary: Unit tests cover essential scenarios: missing file, invalid JSON, invalid URLs, truncation, fallback. Test structure follows unittest pattern.

suggestions.issue: Tests rely on temporary directory changes which may affect other tests if not properly isolated.
suggestions.impact: Low risk because each test uses its own temp directory.
suggestions.recommendation: Consider using unittest.mock.patch to mock file operations instead of physical files.

suggestions.issue: Missing test for feeds.json with duplicate URLs.
suggestions.recommendation: Add test to ensure duplicate URLs are handled (should be allowed).
